center_definition: 4-connected peak component at spatial RF >= 0.25 * positive peak
center_strength_definition: mean spatial RF inside center component

lineage.condition_contract: normal and structural-clamp RF tensors from identical checkpoint, validation input, observed history; only clamp differs

radial_profile_definition: annular mean about condition-specific positive RF peak; radial bin width equals spatial grid step
spatial_extent_definition: equivalent radius sqrt(center support area / pi), in visual degrees
spatial_rf_definition: rank-1 spatial projection using temporal cone-sum projection; oriented to positive center
surround_strength_definition: absolute minimum radial-profile value outside center equivalent radius, floored at zero
